bootstrap.method: Python random.Random(25092026), 10000 shared whole-block draws; percentile CI for median paired difference

limitations: One board, fixed warm crypto state, -Og, 160MHz CPU and ESP-IDF 5.3.2.
Elapsed device time inside Engine::update, including any preemption/driver waits; not intrinsic flash busy time.
No physical power cuts or energy measurement.
Successful requested API bytes; not internal erase commands or measured endurance.
C reuses A slot containing a small envelope, not a fully occupied 64KiB slot.
A→B versus B→C confounded by transition, order and slot; primary comparison is erase policy within the same transition.
No journal rotation in short ABC chains.
Repeated inference vectors are functionality checks, not 9196 independent detection examples.

energy031.estimand: Paced USB end-to-end accepted update, including fixed200ms quiet, not isolatedflashenergy

alignment.uncertainty_kind: empirical envelope of marker residuals, transport brackets and one sample; not metrological bound

limitations: Marker alignment does not calibrate voltage/current, analog bandwidth, filtering or meter self-consumption.
Bounds describe sensitivity of the recorded trace to stated alignment uncertainty and adjacent idle baselines; they are not statistical confidence intervals.
Affine clock fit cannot exclude unobserved nonlinear drift or missing/duplicated physical samples.
Integral uses raw VBUS*IBUS samples, with time mapped to host seconds. Raw CFN/NRG channels are never changed.
Net energy compatible with zero is unresolved, never clipped to zero or used to claim a percentage saving.
One board; repeated blocks are technical repetitions. Whole-firmware energy includes reboot; provisioning outside the block is excluded.
Marker localization was repaired after seeing the failed 030 trace; this is not a successful prespecified energy analysis.

cautions: One physical ESP32-S3; blocks are technical repetitions.
Raw FNB58 U/I integration is exploratory, not calibrated metrology.
Different firmware campaigns 020/025/030 must not be pooled as repetitions of the same setup.
Physical power cuts, secure boot, eFuse anti-rollback and invalid-application rollback were not tested.
No model lifetime prediction from requested flash bytes; no peak RAM claim from response-point free heap.
